title: コウノトリを助けた男。オスは1万3000km飛んで会いに来た【実話】
description: 実話をAI生成映像で再現しました。クロアチアでStjepan Vokićさんは、猟師に撃たれて傷ついたコウノトリのMalenaを助けました。毎年春になると、オスのKlepetanがアフリカから彼女に会いに戻ってきたのです。出典:AFP(France 24、2018年)、CGTN(2020年)。 #コウノトリ #動物 #実話 #感動 #自然 #Shorts

scenes.narration: クロアチアの池のほとりで、傷ついたコウノトリが、もう飛べなくなっていました。
scenes.on_screen_text: 傷ついて飛べないコウノトリ
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level: Malena the white stork struggles in the reeds, one wing dragging on the mud, eyes wide and frightened, at a reed-fringed pond in flat Slavonian farmland, Croatia, under soft grey overcast daylight

scenes.narration: 1993年、学校の用務員だったステパンさんが、池の近くでこのコウノトリを見つけます。
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level: Stjepan in his faded navy flat cap stops short in the reeds, worried and tender expression, slowly kneeling toward the stork, at a reed-fringed pond in flat Slavonian farmland, Croatia, under soft grey overcast daylight

scenes.narration: 猟師に撃たれていたんです。ひとりぼっちだったら、キツネに食べられてしまうところでした。
scenes.on_screen_text: 放っておけばキツネの餌食に
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level: Malena crouches low in the mud, injured wing hanging, trembling and exhausted, at a reed-fringed pond in flat Slavonian farmland, Croatia, under soft grey overcast daylight

scenes.narration: ステパンさんはそっと抱き上げて、自分の家に連れて帰りました。
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level: Stjepan in his faded navy flat cap carefully cradles the stork against his chest, focused and gentle, walking out of the reeds, at a reed-fringed pond in flat Slavonian farmland, Croatia, under soft grey overcast daylight

scenes.narration: 一生懸命お世話をしましたが、翼はもう治りませんでした。
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level: Malena stands in the grass and stretches her wings, one wing hanging lower than the other, calm but unsteady, in the small yard of a village house in Brodski Varoš, Croatia, with a red-tiled brick storage building, in soft morning light

scenes.narration: 秋になると、仲間のコウノトリたちはアフリカへ旅立ちます。彼女だけが残されました。
scenes.on_screen_text: 仲間は旅立つ、彼女は残る
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level: Malena stands still and looks up at a flock of storks flying south, head tilted, lonely expression, in the small yard of a village house in Brodski Varoš, Croatia, with a red-tiled brick storage building, under a pale autumn sky

scenes.narration: そこでステパンさんは、暖房つきで水槽もある、自家製のアフリカを作ってあげたんです。
scenes.on_screen_text: 暖かい手作りアフリカ
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level: Stjepan in his faded navy flat cap arranges straw in a nest next to a heater and an aquarium, proud little smile, inside a small brick storage building turned warm winter room, under warm amber lamp light

scenes.narration: 昼は一緒に魚釣り。夜は一緒にテレビを見て過ごしました。
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level: Stjepan in his faded navy flat cap sits on a stool laughing softly beside Malena, both turned toward a small glowing TV, inside a small brick storage building turned warm winter room with a straw nest, heater and aquarium, under warm amber lamp light

scenes.narration: 春には、屋根の上に大きな巣も作ってあげました。
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level from a ladder: Stjepan in his faded navy flat cap weaves big branches into a huge stick nest, concentrating and smiling, on the red-tiled roof of a small brick storage building in the village of Brodski Varoš, Croatia, under a bright blue spring sky

scenes.narration: それから何年もたったある日、野生のオスが彼女のそばに舞い降りました。
scenes.on_screen_text: 野生のオスが舞い降りた
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level from a ladder: Malena raises her head in surprise and clatters her bill as a wild male stork lands beside her, in the huge stick nest on the red-tiled roof of a small brick storage building in the village of Brodski Varoš, Croatia, under a bright blue spring sky

scenes.narration: ステパンさんは、そのオスをクレペタンと名付けました。毎年秋、クレペタンは飛び立ちます。でもマレナは残ります。
scenes.on_screen_text: 彼は旅立つ。マレナは残る
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level from a ladder: Malena stands alone in the nest, watching a single stork fly away into the distance, quiet and patient, in the huge stick nest on the red-tiled roof of a small brick storage building in the village of Brodski Varoš, Croatia, under a pale autumn sky

scenes.narration: 南アフリカからなんと1万3000キロ以上。日本から南アフリカまでの距離に近い長さです。
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level from a ladder: Malena scans the sky from the nest, neck stretched, hopeful expression, in the huge stick nest on the red-tiled roof of a small brick storage building in the village of Brodski Varoš, Croatia, under a bright blue spring sky

scenes.narration: それでも毎年春になると、彼女のもとへ戻ってきました。2021年まで。
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level from a ladder: Malena throws her head back and clatters her bill joyfully as the male stork lands in the nest beside her, in the huge stick nest on the red-tiled roof of a small brick storage building in the village of Brodski Varoš, Croatia, under a bright blue spring sky

scenes.narration: 2021年7月、マレナは亡くなりました。ステパンさんのそばで過ごした28年でした。
scenes.on_screen_text: ステパンと過ごした28年
scenes.image_prompt: An old white stork resting peacefully in a large rooftop nest at golden hour, eastern Croatian village, handheld phone footage at eye level, soft warm light

scenes.narration: 「私が彼女の運命を変えた。だから責任があるんだ」とステパンさんは語っています。
scenes.image_prompt: Handheld phone footage at eye level: Stjepan in his faded navy flat cap looks up at the two storks in the rooftop nest, eyes moist, a quiet happy smile, in the small yard of a village house in Brodski Varoš, Croatia, with a red-tiled brick storage building, in golden spring evening light
